scripts.deploy:api: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const sha = execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD').toString().trim(); const run = (c) => execSync(c, { stdio: 'inherit' }); run('docker build --provenance=false -t ghcr.io/cristian-israel/watchdesk-api:main -t ghcr.io/cristian-israel/watchdesk-api:' + sha + ' -f deploy/docker/api.Dockerfile .'); run('docker push ghcr.io/cristian-israel/watchdesk-api:main'); run('docker push ghcr.io/cristian-israel/watchdesk-api:' + sha); console.log('sudo ./scripts/atualizar-api.sh ' + sha);"
